OpenAI is connecting ChatGPT to bank accounts via Plaid
2026-05-15.description: OpenAI did this with your health data in January. Now it wants your financial data too. The company announced today that ChatGPT users can connect their bank accounts through Plaid, the financial bridging platform used by 12,000 institutions including Chase, Fidelity, Capital One, and Schwab. Once connected, ChatGPT gets a full view of your balances, transaction history, active subscriptions, investment portfolio, and liabilities like mortgages and credit card debt. In return you get a spending dashboard, personalized financial advice, and a chatbot that can flag unusual changes in your habits. It's launching in preview for Pro subscribers at $200 a month. OpenAI says Plus and eventually everyone else comes later.
